title: Porcelain Axis
desc: A pair of thrown forms rebuilt as one continuous surface. Every silhouette is read from two axes at once, so the profile never resolves into a single front view.

title: Double Axis
desc:
**Curiosity Realized.**

어떻게 하면 더 나은 장면을 만들 수 있을까.  
익숙한 것을 다른 방식으로 바라볼 수는 없을까.  
머릿속에 떠오른 장면을 어떻게 이미지로 옮길 수 있을까.

DOUBLE AXIS는 이러한 호기심을 직접 만들고 확인하기 위해 시작되었습니다.

title: Brawlimas_in_Starfield
desc:
**Doubleaxis **produced media content for Supercell's offline event, "Merry Brawlimas in Starfield.”
Building on its extensive experience operating regular pop-up events and merchandise shops at Starfield Hanam, Hivelab partnered once again as a trusted collaborator, following the previous "Showdown in Starfield" project.
For this project, **Doubleaxis** made active use of Starfield Hanam's media tower and panorama screens to amplify the Christmas atmosphere throughout the venue, and planned, directed, and produced immersive content that allowed visitors to more deeply experience the Brawl Stars Christmas event within the space.

title: Slow Orbit
desc: A twelve second loop built around one deceleration curve. The camera does the acting; nothing else in the frame moves on its own.

title: Field Notice
desc: An identity carried entirely by proportion and rule weight. The mark is a measuring device, so it changes length with the format it sits in.
